title: HEC Establishes Task Force for National University Rankings
excerpt: The Higher Education Commission has created a 22-member national task force to establish a ranking system for universities.
body_html:
The Higher Education Commission has established a new 22-member National Task Force aimed at creating a comprehensive ranking system for universities throughout the country.

Details regarding the specific metrics or timeline for the upcoming ranking system were not provided, but the newly formed group will focus on developing the framework for higher education institutions.
